shadow-component.label: Hand-rolled DS component
shadow-component.blurb: A screen defines a component whose name collides with a real DS export. This matches names, not behaviour — sometimes the two are unrelated components that share a word.

possible-card-reimpl.label: Hand-rolled card
possible-card-reimpl.blurb: A local wrapper renders card-like styling of its own instead of composing CardContainer. Usually a missing composition, not a missing variant — the fix is to keep the wrapper and put CardContainer inside it.

main-overuse.label: variant="main" overuse
main-overuse.blurb: More than one variant="main" in a file. main belongs to the Header primaryAction only — but the check counts per file, and one file can hold several screens.

orphan.label: Orphaned component
orphan.blurb: Committed to src/components/ but imported nowhere. Either wire it into a screen or remove it.
